result.title: Multi-Rate Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling
result.summary: Flow-matching point-cloud upsamplers refine sparse inputs into dense point clouds by integrating a learned velocity field with a fixed temporal discretization. However, local reconstruction requirements vary substantially across a shape, while a shared solver budget applies the same temporal resolution everywhere. We propose Multi-Rate Flow Matching (MRFM), a patch-adaptive framework that selects an integration budget for each local patch at inference time while keeping the learned velocity field frozen. MRFM relaxes the discrete budget into a continuous variable, optimizes it online through differentiable soft rollouts using an input-derived geometric fidelity objective, and projects the result back to a discrete budget for the final solver rollout. Experiments on PU1K and PUGAN show strong reconstruction quality, while matched-budget permutation and multi-factor analyses demonstrate that the benefit depends on patch-specific allocation rather than on the step distribution alone. MRFM is accuracy-oriented and intentionally uses additional test-time optimization to obtain more suitable local temporal resolutions.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MRFM，用于点云上采样：冻结已学速度场，在推理期为每个局部 patch 自适应选择积分步数预算，通过可微软 rollout 与输入导出的几何保真目标在线优化连续预算，再投影回离散步数执行最终求解。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按局部区域分配测试时计算量、以保真目标在线决定步数」的机制，可能为 LVR 中按视觉区域动态分配推理步数与停止决策提供可核查的借鉴；但任务本身是 3D 几何生成，与多模态推理状态无直接联系。
